name: graphql-context
description: Gives Claude a compact summary of your GraphQL schema when you work on queries and resolvers.

schemaPaths.title: Schema files
schemaPaths.description: Comma-separated schema files or globs from the project root (SDL or introspection JSON). Empty: what codegen.yml / .graphqlrc names, else every .graphql/.gql file that defines types.

maxChars.title: Summary size
maxChars.description: Most characters of the compact schema handed to Claude (1000-40000).
